definitions.explanation: A person or business that buys and sells lumber. The suffix {商|しょう} marks a merchant or commercial dealer in the named goods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{材木商|ざいもくしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}んでいる→営む：11837_itonamu⟧。
examples.english: My father runs a lumber business.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{材木商|ざいもくしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何軒|なんけん}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are several old lumber merchants in this town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧{材木商|ざいもくしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{継|つ}いだ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧。
examples.english: My older brother took over the lumber business that has been running since our grandfather's time.

notes:
Refers to either the business or the individual proprietor. Somewhat traditional in feel — a more modern company would be called a ⟦{材木|ざいもく}→材木：04190_zaimoku⟧{会社|がいしゃ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {材木商|ざいもくしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{営|いとな}む→営む：11837_itonamu⟧: to run a lumber business
- {材木商|ざいもくしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{継|つ}ぐ→継ぐ：02292_tsugu⟧: to take over the family lumber business
- ⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{材木商|ざいもくしょう}: a long-established lumber merchant

RELATED {商|しょう} COMPOUNDS:
- {貿易商|ぼうえきしょう}: trader; trading merchant
- {古美術商|こびじゅつしょう}: antique dealer
- {薬種商|やくしゅしょう}: dealer in medicinal goods (old-fashioned)
